import csv

# Load both CSVs
with open\(r''C:\\Users\\farha\\Downloads\\umd_faculty.csv'', ''r'', encoding=''utf-8''\) as f:
    existing = list\(csv.DictReader\(f\)\)

    master = list\(csv.DictReader\(f\)\)

# Emails in existing \(Downloads\)
existing_emails = set\(\)
for r in existing:
    e = \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\).lower\(\)
    if e and e != ''n/a'':
        existing_emails.add\(e\)

# Emails in master
master_emails = set\(\)
for r in master:
    e = \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\).lower\(\)
    if e:
        master_emails.add\(e\)

overlap = existing_emails & master_emails
master_only = master_emails - existing_emails
existing_only = existing_emails - master_emails

print\(f''Existing \(Downloads\) rows: {len\(existing\)}, with email: {len\(existing_emails\)}''\)
print\(f''Master rows: {len\(master\)}, with email: {len\(master_emails\)}''\)
print\(f''Overlap \(shared emails\): {len\(overlap\)}''\)
print\(f''Master-only \(new faculty to add\): {len\(master_only\)}''\)
print\(f''Existing-only \(not in master\): {len\(existing_only\)}''\)
print\(\)

# How many rows in existing have no email?
no_email = sum\(1 for r in existing if not \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\) or \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\).lower\(\) == ''n/a''\)
print\(f''Existing rows with no/N/A email: {no_email}''\)

# For overlap, compare key_expertise quality
print\(\)
print\(''=== Overlap sample: existing vs master key_expertise ===''\)
master_by_email = {}
for r in master:
    e = \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\).lower\(\)
    if e:
        master_by_email[e] = r

count = 0
for r in existing:
    e = \(r.get\(''email''\) or ''''\).strip\(\).lower\(\)
    if e in overlap and count < 3:
        m = master_by_email[e]
        eke = \(r.get\(''key_expertise''\) or ''''\)[:150]
        mke = \(m.get\(''key_expertise''\) or ''''\)[:150]
        print\(f''  {r[""Name""]}''\)
        print\(f''    EXISTING: {eke}''\)
        print\(f''    MASTER:   {mke}''\)
        print\(\)
        count += 1
")
